## Historical audit: S0185

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_199974832/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file’s JSONL lines and supplied character ranges.

| Question | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Task and inferred goal | The student was asked to reconstruct an indoor RGB image with separate meshes, matching geometry, materials, viewpoint and framing, then inspect a render before declaring completion. The intended scene was a 512 × 384 reference image, but its pixels are not included in the supplied observations (line 1, characters [0,5609)). The semantic goal is reconstruction; the actual scene contents cannot be identified from the image path. |
| Actual operations and changes | A fresh, read-only student Codex session was launched with the image; shell and other tools were disabled. The session reports zero tool calls and failed with exit code 1 (line 2, [0,2614)). No student program, scene modification, build or patch is visible. This is not evidence of an intentionally empty patch. |
| Validation and scene-specific checks | No render or visual inspection is visible. Multiple objects, materials or textures, part connections, pose, camera alignment, lighting and render quality therefore remain unverified; even the reference scene’s specific contents are unavailable here (lines 1–4, respective full ranges). |
| Teacher input and adoption | No teacher message, detection, diagnosis, proposed update or executed teacher update appears in this student trajectory. There is consequently no evidence of teacher receipt or adoption (lines 1–4, respective full ranges). |
| Exploration and outcome | No autonomous exploration is visible: the recorded session has zero tool calls. A student `model_error` and subsequent `scene_error` trace the interruption to the Codex process exiting 1 during the initial request (line 3, [0,537); line 4, [0,1600)). The underlying stderr contents are not supplied. **Outcome: technical interruption; reconstruction correctness and formal success are unknown**, not a demonstrated geometric or algorithmic failure. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a failed model invocation can stop a reconstruction before any build or validation; recording the underlying stderr would be necessary to diagnose why. Task-specific hypotheses about missing objects, geometry, materials, pose, camera or lighting cannot be tested from this trace. The image path and requested model identify inputs, not proof that the student interpreted the image or produced a usable response; the session records the actual model as unknown.
